LESSON: KENYAN FOLK DANCE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.10: Kenyan Folk Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Kenyan Folk Dance
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do folk dances represent Kenyan culture?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. classify folk dances from Kenyan communities
2. perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community
3. appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 2: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: classify folk dances from Kenyan communities
2. Practise: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community
